integrity: The result and its proof are supplied in full; finite verification is an independent computational consistency check, not a substitute for the infinite proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No extension to multiple vacant vertices, other graph classes, more than two types or stochastic equilibrium selection; priority remains uncertain for unindexed literature.
scientific_scope: Two agent types with positive sizes on simple cycles of at least four vertices; exactly one vacancy; all strategic; utility is occupied-neighbor fraction of unlike types; only strict improvement counts as a deviation.
title: Fibonacci equilibrium census and exponential balanced-population rarity in diversity-seeking cycle games
